title: Mid-Air results: version 1 ranging (Phases 2 and 4) and version 2 fusion (Phase 11)
description: x-files maps each file's path inside this folder to its definition (first match applies); tests/test_results_schema.py checks every file against it. Written by scripts/results_schema.py from the existing files: required keys are those every file has; shares and probabilities lie in 0 to 1; counts, sizes and times are not negative. Each definition's description names the script that writes the file.

nav_ranging.description: scripts/msckf_ranging.py: terrain-from-motion ranging with fused, exact and assumed poses (D-741)

nav_run.description: scripts/msckf_midair.py: one filter run, per flight and pooled (D-741)
